source: Phase 8 활성 release에 독립 작성한 세 가지 JOIN 전략별 실제 Trino 결과 oracle과 fail-closed 정책 Gate

cases.oracle_sql: SELECT v.hotel_code AS hotel_code, CAST(SUM(v.rating_overall) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT v.voc_review_id), 0) AS voc_average_rating, COUNT(DISTINCT v.voc_review_id) AS voc_average_rating_review_count, SUM(v.rating_overall) AS voc_rating_points FROM serving.analytics_v4_3.voc_review_detail AS v WHERE v.business_date >= DATE '2025-08-01' AND v.business_date < DATE '2025-09-01' GROUP BY v.hotel_code LIMIT 500

cases.query: 2025년 8월 호텔별 객실 매출과 VOC 평균 평점을 함께 알려줘
cases.oracle_sql: WITH hotel AS (SELECT hotel_code, SUM(room_revenue_krw) AS room_revenue_krw FROM serving.analytics_v4_3.hotel_operations_daily WHERE business_date >= DATE '2025-08-01' AND business_date < DATE '2025-09-01' GROUP BY hotel_code), voc AS (SELECT hotel_code, CAST(SUM(rating_overall) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT voc_review_id), 0) AS voc_average_rating, COUNT(DISTINCT voc_review_id) AS voc_average_rating_review_count, SUM(rating_overall) AS voc_rating_points FROM serving.analytics_v4_3.voc_review_detail WHERE business_date >= DATE '2025-08-01' AND business_date < DATE '2025-09-01' GROUP BY hotel_code) SELECT hotel.hotel_code AS hotel_code, hotel.room_revenue_krw AS room_revenue_krw, voc.voc_average_rating AS voc_average_rating, voc.voc_average_rating_review_count AS voc_average_rating_review_count, voc.voc_rating_points AS voc_rating_points FROM hotel INNER JOIN voc ON hotel.hotel_code = voc.hotel_code LIMIT 500

cases.query: 2025년 8월 부정 VOC가 있었던 호텔의 객실 매출을 알려줘
cases.oracle_sql: SELECT SUM(h.room_revenue_krw) AS room_revenue_krw FROM serving.analytics_v4_3.hotel_operations_daily AS h WHERE h.business_date >= DATE '2025-08-01' AND h.business_date < DATE '2025-09-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM serving.analytics_v4_3.voc_review_detail AS v WHERE v.business_date = h.business_date AND v.hotel_code = h.hotel_code AND v.business_date >= DATE '2025-08-01' AND v.business_date < DATE '2025-09-01' AND v.sentiment_label = 'NEGATIVE') LIMIT 500
